reason: I could not re-run the analysis because shell execution was denied, so this rests on reading analysis.py and the report. The estimate is a bare regression with no controls. It omits the 2020 pre-period patents (patents_per_100_eng_2020) and the other 2020 firm characteristics, so confounding and selection into remote work are unaddressed. It also trims the top and bottom 1% of the outcome, so it does not use the full sample (N=1960 of 2000). The 'positive effect' conclusion is not adequately supported. Of the three checks, none of the controls were measured after treatment, because none were used.
